goal: Make the Stop continuation hook nudge at most once per unchanged progress digest and then pause, telling the agent that waiting on a user-only action is a valid stop, under S4 of docs/specs/content-delivery-authority.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Sources E7, U4; meet S4, SCN-3 and D11 in docs/specs/content-delivery-authority.spec.md: on both Hosts an unchanged progress digest blocks once and the next unchanged stop pauses; a changed digest blocks again; the block reason says that waiting on a user-only action is a valid stop and must not repeat the request.
